create_hub_cache_endpoint: create an SSE endpoint that streams hub cache updates to subscribed clients using a HubCacheWatcher
subscribe_to_hub_cache_events: subscribe to hub cache events and receive real-time ServerSentEvent updates via an async generator
handle_sse_errors: handle CancelledError and generic exceptions in an SSE async generator by yielding error events
run_hub_cache_initialization: run full hub cache initialization on subscribe when the all query parameter is set to true
unsubscribe_from_hub_cache: unsubscribe a client from hub cache events and clean up the initialization task on disconnect
